| 住所 | 〒542-0074 大阪市中央区千日前1-9-1 |

| その他 | 【席数】1F:95席／2F：22席 【禁煙・喫煙】禁煙 【モーニングの提供】平日のみあり 【予約の可否】平日のみ可能 |

 道頓堀・法善寺といった”こてこて大阪”の中心、ミナミのど真ん中に千日前本店があります。 2階は約30名様収容可能で、平日に限り会合や２次会などの貸切のご予約をお受けいたします。 田辺聖子著「薔薇の雨」で小説の舞台として登場したりと、昔から老若男女世代にかかわらず珈琲好きのお客様に愛されてまいりました。アンティークな調度品に飾られたレトロな空間でゆったりとした時間をお過ごしいただけます。 千日前本店のおすすめメニューの、銅板でやきあげる懐かしい味と香りのホットケーキは、料理研究家の小林カツ代氏も愛して下さる丸福オリジナルレシピです。オーダーを頂いてから１枚１枚焼き上げるホットケーキにたっぷりのバターと蜂蜜・メープルシロップでお召し上がり下さい。

## Information from the store

Established in 1934. Enjoy coffee with a rich aroma, old-fashioned hotcakes, and seasonal sweets. Since their establishment in 1934, Marufuku Coffee has prided themselves on coffee with a rich aroma and flavor. Their roasting technique is nicknamed “the ultimate dark roast,” and their coffee is made using an extraction device invented by the company's founder — but their coffee also requires the skilled hand of an expert to perfectly bring these together. The menu also offers hotcakes, custard pudding, a frequently updated selection of sweets made by pastry chefs, and more items that have been beloved for decades. Marufuku takeout items are also available.

results.author: Stancy
highlights:
## Marufuku Coffee Sennichimae Main Store Getting There | A Popular Longstanding Café Near Dotonbori

Name: Marufuku Coffee Sennichimae Main Store (MARUFUKU COFFEE) Address: 1 Chome-9-1 Sennichimae, Chuo Ward, Osaka, 542-0074, Japan Our original guide gives about three minutes on foot from Nipponbashi Station or five minutes from Namba Station. This is the Sennichimae main store in the Namba area, separate from Marufuku’s other Osaka branches. Our visit guide listed 08:00–23:00, last orders 22:30. The shop’s current store page could not be retrieved during this check, so confirm service hours before an early or late visit. On our photographed egg-feature menu, each sandwich was ¥1,150 including tax on its own, or ¥1,645 with a listed set drink. The separate morning menu had other options until 11:00. These are visit-menu prices; check current menus and serving times.

The location is incredibly convenient, close to both Kuromon Market and the Dotonbori shopping area. It’s a great place to stop for breakfast and coffee before starting your day’s itinerary.

...

## Marufuku Coffee Menu

 

## Breakfast at Marufuku Coffee | Thick Omelet Sandwich & Egg Salad Sandwich

## The Star of Breakfast at Marufuku Coffee | The Ultimate Egg Sandwich

We chose two egg sandwiches for breakfast and enjoyed comparing their textures. The photographed feature menu gives their exact names and set choices.

### Dashi-Rolled Egg Sandwich

 

The rolled-egg sandwich had thick, soft layers of egg. Our menu photograph names a dashi version of Tamagodake and describes using stock from the long-established egg specialist Mikuri in Kobe. I enjoyed its savoury flavour, without assuming a specific bonito recipe.

The soft white bread paired well with the thick omelet and did not feel dry or heavy. I liked the contrast between the egg and bread; it was a satisfying part of our breakfast.

### Original Egg Sandwich: Ganso Tamagodake

 

Compared with the thick omelet version, the egg salad sandwich offers a different kind of comfort. Marufuku’s egg salad is smooth and moist with a little texture from finely chopped boiled eggs. The gentle flavor of mayonnaise comes through in just the right amount, without being too oily or too tangy.

It uses their specially made, light and soft white bread, which has a slightly chilled feel that makes each bite cool and refreshing—perfect for the morning. To me, this is the breakfast that goes best with coffee. It doesn’t leave you feeling weighed down; instead, it makes you want to slowly finish a whole iced café au lait.

Both sandwiches can be made into a set with a drink. I recommend their iced café au lait or hot coffee. The iced café au lait is a highlight here! Their house-roasted beans have a rich aroma, balanced by just the right amount of milk. As the ice slowly melts, the coffee aroma seems to grow stronger. One sip and you’re hooked. The menu calls the milk coffee café au lait; it is not proof that an espresso-based latte was served.

## Recommended Desserts and Drinks | Seasonal Autumn Mont Blanc Pancakes & Iced Café au Lait

The autumn Mont Blanc pancakes on the visit menu looked tempting, with chestnut cream and ice cream pictured. I was too full from breakfast to order them and only saw another diner’s serving. I cannot offer a first-hand tasting review of that pancake dish. Seasonal availability changes.
